sloka: प्लवैः क्रौञ्चैः च संपूर्णाम् महा मृग निषेविताम् ।अधिकम् शोभते पम्पा विकूजद्भिः विहङ्गमैः ॥४-१-९९॥
transliteration: plavaiḥ krauñcaiḥ ca saṁpūrṇām mahā mṛga niṣevitām ।adhikam śobhate pampā vikūjadbhiḥ vihaṅgamaiḥ ॥4-1-99॥

translations.english: Pampa, filled with swimming, kraunchas and frequented by big animals looks splendid. The joyous warbling of a variety of birds is highly exciting. They kindle my passion for my young, Moonfaced, lotus eyed beloved.
